title: Christmas High Tea at The Marley House
seo_title: Christmas High Tea at The Marley House in Ozark, MO
description: This is a holiday high tea at The Marley House, where guests enjoy a tower of sweet and savory bites with a choice of tea from Phoenix Tea Company, plus additional drinks from the bar. Guests can bring a new toy for Santa's Toy Drive and receive a $10 voucher for The Mill, valid through February 28, 2027, for each toy; seating is pre-assigned and groups must book under the same reservation. It is for guests ages 7 and up, and takes place Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 4:00 PM at 802 Finley Farms Lane in Ozark, MO.
